# HV World

> HV World is a set of three free, AI-powered web apps for personal and career growth, made by Harsh Goyal (India) and launched on 1 October 2026. The apps run in any browser on phone or laptop, with nothing to install. HV AI, the built-in assistant, understands English, Hindi and Hinglish, typed or spoken, and always asks before it changes anything.

- Website: https://harshvittori.github.io/
- Price: free for everyone, HV AI included
- Made by: Harsh Goyal (https://www.linkedin.com/in/harshvittori)

## The three apps

- [HV Test](https://harshvittori.github.io/test/): self-assessment tests. Start with the free Maturity Assessment (28 to 30 real-life situations): a score out of 100, a level, a checkable scorecard with a unique ID, a full report PDF and a 30-day plan. No login. Open the app: https://harshvittori.github.io/hv-tests/
- [HV Reset](https://harshvittori.github.io/reset/): a daily planner that shows one task at a time, shifts the whole day when you run late, and gives you a personal dashboard for time, focus, streaks and progress. Open the app: https://harshvittori.github.io/hv-reset/
- [HV Vault](https://harshvittori.github.io/vault/): a job-search tracker for every job, company, recruiter, follow-up and interview, with a pipeline board, resume vault and analytics. Tell HV AI what happened and it updates the board. Google sign-in keeps your data private. Open the app: https://harshvittori.github.io/hv-vault-web/

- [Privacy policy](https://harshvittori.github.io/privacy/) and [Terms](https://harshvittori.github.io/terms/)
- Check an HV Test scorecard: https://harshvittori.github.io/hv-tests/verify/

## Facts

- HV Test results are for personal growth, not a clinical or psychological diagnosis.
- Who it's for: students, job seekers, working professionals, anyone who wants to know themselves better and stay consistent.
